hypotheses.title: Loop metadata inheritance can destroy vectorization
hypotheses.statement: When the second fusion candidate carries vectorize(disable) or narrower vectorization metadata, the fused loop inherits FC1's llvm.loop metadata and can lose FC0's vectorization. The exact-reuse gate accepts the fusion even when the resulting scalar loop is much slower in cache-resident regimes.
hypotheses.motivation: Stage 0 measured a roughly 2x regression for a metadata conflict; this is a concrete false positive of the current profitability gate.
competing_explanations: fused-body size or unroll-factor loss
cache stream conflicts
measurement noise or code layout
front-end/IR compatibility shim effects
evidence_required: matched IR and assembly for fusion on/off
reproduction on a consistent toolchain without ir_compat.py
hypotheses.falsification: The regression disappears when the metadata conflict is removed, or it cannot be reproduced on a matched toolchain.
hypotheses.review_note: Stage 0 analysis is self-review only; no independent audit yet.
hypotheses.decision: Retain as an engineering hypothesis; do not promote to supported before R1-A.
hypotheses.next_action: Repeat the metadata contrast on a matched clang/LLVM revision.

hypotheses.title: Exact-affine RAR rejects profitable shifted reuse
hypotheses.statement: The exact (start, step) RAR key rejects legal reuse when the second loop reads A[i+k] for a small constant k != 0, even though fusion can reduce a full memory pass and is profitable for large working sets.
hypotheses.motivation: Stage 0 measured 17-32% gains from forced fusion of A[i] and A[i+1] while the current model rejected it.
competing_explanations: shifted accesses may be unaligned or cross cache lines
fusion may hurt at cache-resident sizes
the benefit may not generalize beyond this kernel
evidence_required: correctness and legality check of the shifted fusion
hypotheses.falsification: Shifted RAR fusion is not legal, is incorrect, or does not reproduce a gain on a matched toolchain and broader corpus.
hypotheses.decision: Retain as a candidate false negative; test broader stencil patterns before proposing a patch.
hypotheses.next_action: Add shifted stencil cases to the R1 corpus and rerun on a matched toolchain.

hypotheses.title: Fusion benefit depends on working-set residency
hypotheses.statement: For exact read-read reuse, the benefit of fusion grows with the reused stream footprint relative to cache capacity, approaching zero when the second pass would already hit in cache.
hypotheses.motivation: Stage 0 measured a monotonic increase from roughly 0% at L1/L2 to about 31% at DRAM for aligned read-read.
competing_explanations: loop overhead and unrolling
load elimination or its absence
prefetcher and memory-level parallelism effects
allocator/layout artifacts
evidence_required: reproduction on other targets and with counters where available
hypotheses.falsification: Benefit is independent of footprint, or the apparent trend is explained by a confounder.
hypotheses.review_note: No hardware counters; cache attribution remains an inference.
hypotheses.decision: Retain as a predictive feature candidate; requires counters or stronger controls.
hypotheses.next_action: Test a cache-footprint rule against held-out benchmark families.

hypotheses.title: Canonical rotated loops are rejected by DA/latch mapping
hypotheses.statement: Clang-style rotated loops with the body in the header/latch block are rejected for RAW reuse fusion because DependenceAnalysis does not produce the fused-level direction, while a hand-written separate-latch form is accepted.
hypotheses.motivation: Stage 0 found InvalidDependencies for a normal producer-consumer C++ kernel but a 12-32% win for an equivalent separate-latch IR kernel.
competing_explanations: the canonical loop is not actually legal to fuse
the split IR changes more than the latch structure
the profitability filter, not legality, is responsible
evidence_required: minimal pair differing only in latch/body structure
hypotheses.falsification: A minimal canonical clang loop is accepted or the split form is rejected for an unrelated legality reason.
hypotheses.decision: Retain as a compiler-legality finding; separate from profitability.
hypotheses.next_action: Reduce to a minimal canonical/split pair and check LLVM source behavior.

hypotheses.title: The RFC 6.52% VW16 regression is not reproducible here
hypotheses.statement: On the pinned Stage 0 machine and build, the exact llvm-test-suite VW16 uint64-to-uint8 benchmark does not show the RFC's 6.52% regression; the effect is within campaign noise.
hypotheses.motivation: Two exact benchmark campaigns gave -2.6%/+2.7% for unrestricted fusion, with no stable sign.
competing_explanations: different CPU or AVX-512 code generation
different fusion order or inlining
five-run medians without intervals in the RFC
measurement noise
evidence_required: code-generation comparison with the RFC setup
hypotheses.falsification: A matched-toolchain rerun reproduces a stable regression with a concrete codegen cause.
hypotheses.review_note: Absence of reproduction on one machine is not a refutation of the RFC.
hypotheses.decision: Do not use the 6.52% number as a fixed target or sole motivation.
hypotheses.next_action: Reproduce on a matched toolchain and, if possible, an AVX-512 host.

hypotheses.title: Key Stage 0 findings survive a matched toolchain
hypotheses.statement: The metadata, shifted-reuse, cache-residency and canonical-loop findings reproduce qualitatively when clang and LLVM come from one pinned revision and no ir_compat.py metadata transformation is used.
hypotheses.motivation: Stage 0 mixed clang 23.1.5 with LLVM 24.0.0git and removed alias-scope constructs; independent validation is required before R1.
competing_explanations: the compatibility shim changed the phenomenon
the effect is specific to the Stage 0 binaries
the exact benchmark result was noise
evidence_required: rerun of the five Stage 0 examples
hypotheses.falsification: A key finding disappears or reverses under matched tools.
hypotheses.decision: First R1 workstream; blocks mechanism and predictor work.
hypotheses.next_action: Create an R1-A run record with a matched toolchain manifest.

hypotheses.title: The protocol can be followed without the original transcript
hypotheses.statement: A fresh session can read the state index, activate the correct role, produce a handoff, and record a review using only repository files.
hypotheses.motivation: The harness must survive context resets and multiple agent runtimes.
competing_explanations: the simulation was authored by the same model that designed the harness
a real experiment may reveal missing fields or ambiguous steps
hypotheses.falsification: A fresh session cannot complete the workflow without hidden context.
hypotheses.review_note: Infrastructure smoke test only; not independent validation.
hypotheses.decision: Provisional acceptance of the harness structure; collect real-run feedback.
hypotheses.next_action: Use the harness for R1-A and record any friction.

hypotheses.title: Exact LRU distribution for fixed-frequency traces
hypotheses.statement: For a uniformly random permutation of a fixed multiset, the finite-state DP over remaining counts and LRU cache contents gives the exact miss-count distribution; for capacity one the expected misses equal 1 + N - sum(n_i^2)/N.
hypotheses.motivation: Provide an exact mathematical baseline before claiming any compiler relevance.
competing_explanations: The DP may be numerically correct but irrelevant to hardware or LLVM.
evidence_required: proof of the recurrence and capacity-one formula
hypotheses.falsification: A counterexample where the recurrence or formula disagrees with exhaustive enumeration, or a proof gap.
hypotheses.review_note: Exact rational checks pass, but no independent review or complete prior-art audit.
hypotheses.decision: Retain as a mathematical baseline; do not claim novelty or compiler predictive value.
hypotheses.next_action: Seek independent review and test incremental predictive value on held-out static features.

hypotheses.title: Partial orders change achievable LRU miss statistics
hypotheses.statement: For small labeled posets, uniform linear extensions can change the mean and range of LRU misses relative to unconstrained multiset permutations.
hypotheses.motivation: Compiler fusion changes the legal interleaving of accesses; a partial-order model may describe the feasible schedules.
competing_explanations: The effect is an artifact of toy posets or the uniform-extension assumption.
hypotheses.falsification: No poset-derived statistic predicts anything beyond simpler static features, or the distribution assumption is unjustified.
hypotheses.review_note: Four toy posets only; no compiler connection.
hypotheses.next_action: Define a schedule distribution tied to loop fusion and test it against measured cases.
